name: Rajesh Gorana
headline: Senior Quality Engineering Manager
summary: Senior Quality Engineering leader with 15 years of experience driving QE transformation across retail, e-commerce and investment platforms. Expert in building automation-first QE practices for web, API and microservices environments using Playwright, Selenium, Rest Assured, Java and Python. Experienced in designing Agentic QE solutions for AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation and intelligent failure analysis. Proven track record leading distributed teams of 15–20 engineers, defining QE strategy and KPIs, integrating CI/CD pipelines and delivering measurable improvements in test efficiency and defect reduction.
achievements: Improved defect detection performance from 84% to 95%.
Reduced regression and functional validation effort by approximately 50–60%.
Reduced selected regression execution cycles from 45 hours to approximately 15 hours.
Reduced manual regression effort by 60% on the Ratings Analytical Platform through automation.
Reduced Fidelity regression execution time by 50% through Selenium and Jenkins automation.
Maintained zero critical production defects for multiple consecutive quarters on relevant delivery work.
Won Director's Award for quality work delivered on an Investment Platform project at Fidelity.
ai_agentic_qe: Designed an AI-agent-driven quality engineering platform.
